Baldwin Hardware, known for its luxurious solid brass craftsmanship, has partnered with Level, an

pairs Baldwin’s iconic style with Level’s innovative engineering—featuring a hidden battery housed
within the bolt— to set a new standard in secure, stylish, smart-living.
[Explore Level][72]
[Severin Fayerman]

#### Since 1946, Baldwin has believed that the smallest details define a home.

Founded by Severin Fayerman, the brand was built on an uncompromising commitment to solid brass
craftsmanship, precise engineering, and timeless design. What began in Reading, Pennsylvania,
remains a standard for architectural hardware made to endure—crafted with intention, restraint, and
lasting beauty.

[Experience our Legacy][73]

### Find the Right Lock

Tubular or mortise? Not all locks are created equal, and there are several types of keyed locks
including mortise, cylindrical, tubular and rim locks. Learn the difference between the two most
popular lock styles so you can choose the one that best fits your door. Or dive deeper into finding
the right lock.
* [Tubular Lock]
  Tubular
  Tubular or standard door prep is most common in North America. Standard prep requires a 2 1/8”
  diameter bore hole through the door. Baldwin offers a wide array of options of tubular handlesets.
* [Mortise Lock]
  Mortise
  Mortise door preparation is named for the mortised pocket cut into the edge of the door
  (approximately 6" high by 4" deep) and is seen more often on custom and solid wood doors. While
  this does take more expertise to install, this lock type is known for being more heavy duty, and
  secure. Baldwin has had a long tradition of exceptional mortise door locks.

## The Spoke Knob

Be it art, architecture or interior design, Emtek products take inspiration from all walks of
life—including our daily commute. Echoing the wheel of a bicycle, the Spoke Knob is the flagship
piece in the Studio Brass line dedicated to bringing boutique design straight to your door.

[Get a Closer Look][74]

## The Galapagos Project

Emtek has developed a computer algorithm, capable of generating patterns that mimic the variations
seen in nature. A limited series of truly unique patterns will be generated and produced with 3D
printed metals. Each 3D printed handle will represent their own variation of The Galapagos Project.
Emulating nature, no two pieces will be identical.

Emtek has developed a computer algorithm, capable of generating patterns that mimic the variations
seen in nature. A limited series of truly unique patterns will be generated and produced with 3D

### ABOUT INDIA INTERNATIONAL HOUSE LTD.

# Building Excellence Since 1976

Since 1976, India International House Ltd. has manufactured architectural and builder hardware and
precision components with the same commitment to durability and design. From door handles and hinges
to custom-engineered brackets, housings, and extruded profiles, our products are trusted by leading
brands, OEMs, and project partners worldwide.

With vertically integrated manufacturing, skilled craftsmanship, and strict quality systems, we
deliver reliable solutions that perform consistently, batch after batch, shipment after shipment.

## Responsible Manufacturing

Our operations are designed to minimize impact and maximize efficiency:

Eco-friendly surface care systems reduce chemical use and conserve water.

Effluent treatment plants across all units ensure safe treatment and discharge of wastewater.

Induction furnaces lower energy consumption and emissions compared to conventional methods.

Trivalent chrome facilities provide a safer, more environmentally responsible plating process.

Sustainable packaging is developed to minimize material waste and support recyclability.

# Certified & Audit-Ready

Our facilities and processes meet international quality and compliance standards:
* ISO 9001:2015: Quality Management
* ISO 14001:2015: Environmental Management
* ISO 45001:2018: Occupational Health & Safety
* RoHS Compliant: Safe materials and finishes
* SMETA / C-TPAT: Ethical trade and secure supply chains

[Certification][28]

### OUR SERVICES

# Delivering Excellence in Every Detail

With 50 years of manufacturing expertise and advanced production capabilities, India International
House Ltd. offers a complete range of solutions for architects, builders, importers, and OEM
partners worldwide.

##### Strict Quality Assurance

[services]

Every part undergoes salt-spray, thermal/humidity, adhesion, and color-matching tests, backed by ISO
9001/14001/45001 and RoHS compliance.

##### In-House Manufacturing

[services]

Tooling, forming, machining, finishing, and packaging under one roof, ensuring tighter control,
faster sampling, and consistent delivery.

##### Premium Finishes

[services]

From polished brass to advanced PVD coatings, we offer a wide spectrum of finishes designed for
durability, corrosion resistance, and long-term color stability.

##### Global Supply Network

[services]

Our export logistics expertise and packaging solutions enable dependable, on-time deliveries to OEMs
and partners in 60+ countries.

[ [take your pleasure seriously: play as a way of being] ][48]

### [ take your pleasure seriously: play as a way of being ][49]

what if form didn't follow function, but pleasure? long before we built anything, we played, turning
a cardboard box into a spaceship and a patch of floor into an ocean. play here is not frivolity, but
our first creative act, the moment imagination learns that reality is negotiable. this chapter
explores what happens when we design not to save time, but to spend it well, rejecting efficiency as
the highest virtue in favor of warmth, spontaneity, and joy. to choose delight while the world feels
heavy is not to look away from it, but to remember what makes it worth carrying.

by sofia lekka angelopoulou

[ [take your pleasure seriously: play as a way of being] ][48]

### [ take your pleasure seriously: play as a way of being ][49]

what if form didn't follow function, but pleasure? long before we built anything, we played, turning
a cardboard box into a spaceship and a patch of floor into an ocean. play here is not frivolity, but
our first creative act, the moment imagination learns that reality is negotiable. this chapter
explores what happens when we design not to save time, but to spend it well, rejecting efficiency as
the highest virtue in favor of warmth, spontaneity, and joy. to choose delight while the world feels
heavy is not to look away from it, but to remember what makes it worth carrying.

by sofia lekka angelopoulou

# Door Handle Manufacturer and Supplier for Wholesale and OEM Orders

Archtek Hardware is a China-based door handle manufacturer and supplier located in Tengqiao Town,
Wenzhou, Zhejiang. Since 2013, we have supplied door handles and related door hardware for hardware
wholesalers, door hardware importers, building material distributors, door manufacturers, private
label brands, retail chain buyers and project purchasers.

Our main product range covers lever handles, pull handles, sliding door handles, glass door handles
and supporting door hardware accessories. We support wholesale orders, OEM / ODM projects, custom
finish, logo marking, private label packaging, accessory matching, sample confirmation, quality
checking and export shipment preparation.

## About Us

For over two decades, Enger has been promoting innovative and functional solutions that combine the
highest quality with aesthetics and ergonomics. Our products are characterized not only by excellent
design but also by durability and reliability, making them the perfect choice for the most demanding
customers.

The brands **APRILE**, **STILE**, and **STERK** are synonymous with elegance and modernity,
seamlessly fitting into a variety of interior designs, from classic to contemporary. Our attention
to detail and continuous improvement of our offerings have earned us the trust of a wide range of
customers, both in Poland and internationally.

Enger is not just a manufacturer of door handles; we are a partner dedicated to supporting our
clients in realizing their visions and interior design projects. Our mission is to provide solutions
that enhance spaces, highlighting their unique character and style.

We guarantee the highest quality craftsmanship and user comfort of every sold door handle.

# Welcome to Gedore Lock Industries

### Established in the year 1992 “Gedore Lock Industries”.

The Gedore story began in 1992 with the manufacture of locks. Since then, Gedore locks industries
have brought many innovative products in the lacks industry. with the experience of 25 years in the
market, the company has set major challenges for the competition regarding the best quality product
and fast services from a state-of-the-art manufacturing and trading facility in Aligarh, Gedore
locks industries providing locking solutions that reach home, office, industries, and several parts
of India.

[More About Us][31]

## Our Products

Our locks manufacturing Company has many modern products. We have almost 25 years of experience in
the market, and have set major challenges for the competition by committed to providing the best
quality product and fast services from a state-of-the-art manufacturing and trading facility in
Aligarh. We manufacture and supply a range of locks for home, office, industries. Our products reach
different parts of the country. As one of the renowned locks manufacturing companies, we have come a
long way in delivering the best locking solutions.

Our locks are used in lockers, metal panels, furniture, and electrical units. We offer a broad
variety of unique stylish locks all over in India. These locks are mostly installed at smaller and
medium-duty safes. They are known for durability, quality, and functionality. We can make the best
quality of furniture locks. These locks are offered with a combination of different keys as per your
requirement. These Locks are used in different applications.

**Features**

Available with master key system

Also used as cabinet locks

Rust-resistant body

Customization

When you select a [**Best Quality Glass lock Manufacturers**][32], you can be sure you've done the
job right, the first time, because these days our products are the strong and reliable. In addition,
our locks are very easy to fix, and simple to repair and maintain. These locks provide total safety
and security for our customers.

As a leading name in the industry, we keep a regular vigil at every stage of manufacturing to ensure
the quality and reliability of our products. The best quality raw material is used to maintain the
quality of our products which is our hallmark in the market.

**Our range of locking systems is broad. We can offer:**
* Door locks
* Cupboard locks
* Glass locks
* Padlocks
* Multi-purpose locks
* Heavy-duty interlocks
* Sliding locks
* And other special locks.


We provide locking systems to leading manufacturers of **lockers, safes, wooden and metal office

Welcome to Manovella Design

We are a Melbourne-based team specialising in high-quality residential door and cabinet hardware
that balances style with everyday durability. Whether you are a homeowner picking out the perfect
[cabinet handles][221] for a kitchen renovation, or a builder specifying a full suite of [internal
door levers][222] for a client, we provide the expert-led advice you need to get the job done right.

Everything in our shop is chosen with a simple rule in mind: "*We only stock what we would be proud
to use in our own homes*". It’s this "no-shortcuts" approach to quality that has earned us 5-star
reviews from DIY renovators and design professionals alike. To ensure your project remains
stress-free, we back our entire range with a **10-year mechanical warranty **and provide a flexible
**90-day return policy**.

### Two locksmiths, one vision

We’re not a faceless retailer. Manovella was founded by two Melbourne locksmiths who wanted to
create beautiful, reliable hardware without the mark-ups.

**Why choose us over the big guys?**
* Products designed by locksmiths, not boardrooms
* Local Melbourne stock with fast delivery
* A warehouse showroom where you can meet us in person
* Real advice from two experts who’ve worked with hardware for 30+ years

precision zinc alloy construction - no hollow-cast handles, no cosmetic-only finishes, no products
that look good in a photo but fail within a year.

We know exactly how handles fail, what causes mechanisms to seize, and which finishes hold up in
humid bathrooms and coastal conditions.

Welcome to Manovella Design

We are a Melbourne-based team specialising in high-quality residential door and cabinet hardware
that balances style with everyday durability. Whether you are a homeowner picking out the perfect
[cabinet handles][221] for a kitchen renovation, or a builder specifying a full suite of [internal
door levers][222] for a client, we provide the expert-led advice you need to get the job done right.

Everything in our shop is chosen with a simple rule in mind: "*We only stock what we would be proud
to use in our own homes*". It’s this "no-shortcuts" approach to quality that has earned us 5-star
reviews from DIY renovators and design professionals alike. To ensure your project remains
stress-free, we back our entire range with a **10-year mechanical warranty **and provide a flexible
**90-day return policy**.

### Two locksmiths, one vision

We’re not a faceless retailer. Manovella was founded by two Melbourne locksmiths who wanted to
create beautiful, reliable hardware without the mark-ups.

**Why choose us over the big guys?**
* Products designed by locksmiths, not boardrooms
* Local Melbourne stock with fast delivery
* A warehouse showroom where you can meet us in person
* Real advice from two experts who’ve worked with hardware for 30+ years

## We Don't Stock Hardware We Wouldn't Install Ourselves


With over 30 years fitting and servicing door hardware professionally, we know what fails in the
real world - and we won't stock it.

That knowledge shapes every product we carry. Our entire range uses solid brass, stainless steel, or
precision zinc alloy construction - no hollow-cast handles, no cosmetic-only finishes, no products
that look good in a photo but fail within a year.

We know exactly how handles fail, what causes mechanisms to seize, and which finishes hold up in
humid bathrooms and coastal conditions.

Every [door handle][257], [cabinet handle][258], [hinge, and ][259][door stop][260] we sell is
covered by a [10-year mechanical warranty][261]. Not because we have to offer it - because we're
confident enough to.

#### Solid materials, always

Solid brass, solid Zinc Alloy and stainless steel construction. [PVD-coated finishes][262] resist
corrosion, tarnish, and wear - particularly important in coastal and high-humidity Australian
environments.

#### Fair pricing for premium products

We sell at high volume online, which lets us keep prices fair without compromising on materials.

## Doors designed to make life and living better

solutions

At Masonite, we create Doors That Do More™ for the people who pass through them every day. We
believe doors should connect you with the people and things you care about most — and make life
easier, safer and more beautiful, too.

[

### Doors that reduce noise

Keep sound where it belongs—in or out of a room—with sound-dampening doors.

Learn more ][40]
[
[Modern entry way with a blue exterior front door with three panels and silver handle the house has
brown wood paneling wall on one side and a plain white wall with a long window and trees]

### Doors that enhance safety

doors.

Learn more ][41]
[
[A young girl walking through gray double front doors, each with 3/4 lite glass pane]

### Doors that increase light

Bring natural light into your home with doors that have more visible glass area.

Learn more ][42]
[

### Doors that conserve energy

Stay comfortable inside, whatever the weather is outside, with an exterior door system that provides
better protection from the elements.

][43]
[

### Doors that elevate style

Complement your home’s design with our curated collection of doors for the whole home.

][44]

Dal 1911 Olivari realizza maniglie in Italia,
all’interno dei propri stabilimenti, dove si svolge l’intero ciclo produttivo.
La ricerca e l’innovazione tecnologica, il dialogo continuo tra tradizione e modernità
e la collaborazione con i più importanti architetti e designer di tutto il mondo
rendono Olivari sinonimo di eccellenza, punto di riferimento per l’eleganza e la qualità del
prodotto.

## Un catalogo con più di 100 maniglie

#### Il catalogo Olivari è composto da più di 100 maniglie e presenta pezzi storici, best-sellers
#### intramontabili e novità firmate dai più grandi designers e architetti internazionali.

### Maniglie Square

La serie Square si caratterizza per la forma quadrata delle componenti tecniche (rosetta, bocchetta,
placca, …) e per la geometria a sviluppo lineare delle impugnature.

### Maniglie Round

La serie Round si caratterizza per la forma tonda delle componenti tecniche (rosetta, bocchetta,
placca, …) e per la geometria variabile delle impugnature.

### Maniglie Special

I prodotti della seria Special si caratterizzano per ricercatezza e originalità di forme e materiali
delle impugnature.

## Quality **Commitment**

Ouken Hardware strictly follows the ISO9001 quality management system and national industry
standards, and establishes a complete quality management system. Our quality control team will
comprehensively monitor the production process and promptly correct and handle non-conforming
products to ensure the consistency of product quality.
Every product must pass a stringent 12-stage quality inspection process, ensuring long-term
durability and performance on doors in both private estates and high-traffic public spaces.
[ View More][69]
[index-img]

## Redefinition Industry **Standard**

To achieve excellence in door handle manufacturing, we have established a unique “dual-track”
production system within our** 4,800 sqm** modern facility, which masterfully blends precision
manufacturing with artisanal craftsmanship. Sixteen high-precision **CNC machining** centers
guarantee millimeter-perfect consistency for handle components, while our team of experienced
artisans imbues each piece with unique character and texture through hand-hammering and fine
finishing techniques.

standards, and establishes a complete quality management system. Our quality control team will
comprehensively monitor the production process and promptly correct and handle non-conforming
products to ensure the consistency of product quality.

guarantee millimeter-perfect consistency for handle components, while our team of experienced
artisans imbues each piece with unique character and texture through hand-hammering and fine
finishing techniques.

## Customer Testimonials

See what our customers have to say about us

AM Andrew M. (Truganina, VIC)

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

#### "Great!"

I now have three of the "SmartDL 5-in-1" locks on exterior doors, plus one of the "Ultraloq UL1"
locks on an interior door (as a privacy lock). As an aside, I also have one Samsung electronic
deadbolt. The 3 x SmartDL's and 1 x Ultraloq are FAR superior to the Samsung lock from a fingerprint
recognition point of view. The 4 locks from SmartDoorLocks all work 9+ times out of 10 while the
Samsung almost always requires a second and even third attempt.

EB Emanuele B. (Yarraville, VIC)

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

#### Great company!

Good device and great support. despite they do not do installation. they organized the fitters for
me, which was fast, good and at honest price.

FF Farzana F. (Caroline Springs, VIC)

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

#### Stylish looking door lock

love our new digital lock door handle. first of all it looks really nice. It's not bulky and matches
our door really well. its functional and easy to use. i would highly recommend it. best of all you
have the peace of mind.

HR Helen R. (North Avoca, NSW)

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

#### Thanks so much for amazing service!

I have honestly never dealt with a company so organised! Website, instructions, product and shipping
(ordered Wednesday, delivered Thursday!!!) have all exceeded our expectations. I will definitely be
recommending you guys and ordering again. Well done :)

LR Lisa R. (Ainslie, ACT)

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

#### Brilliant locks

I’m always concerned at how difficult fitting electronic locks can be - however my experience with
smart door locks was fantastic. The locks worked as described; they fitted my wooden glass doors
perfectly where I replaced old mechanical locks; and the responsiveness from the company to my
questions was quick and decisive. I highly recommend them!!

MW Matthew W. (Parkdale, VIC)

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I purchased both the SDL-H1 & SDL-S1 Slim and we are very happy with both products thus far. We are
building at the moment, so I must confess that I did not install the locks myself however the
programming of fingerprints and access codes through the app was very easy and user friendly. Prior
to purchasing I had some questions and I was very impressed with the timely responses and answers I
received from the customer service team. Can't wait to move into our house and start using the door
locks daily.

SL Sharee L. (Strathfield, NSW)

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

#### Highly recommend

Was skeptical about purchasing a lock online after looking at other shops. Read the reviews and we
are so happy. Easy to install does everything it says and perfect for those who want to lock up and
access without keys. The fingerprint and timing lockup works like a charm. Service was impeccable we
called and receive assistance immediately. Would highly recommend this product life saver with all
these teenagers coming and going all hours of the night !

SB Sonia B. (Hornsby, NSW)

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

#### Working beautifully- great quality

Great quality item. We are all enjoying getting in the house using our fingerprint. Great not having
to worry about the teenagers losing let their keys or getting locked out. The only feedback is
having better installation instructions. The ad said easy to install but took my husband half a day
as he didn’t have all the tools. Be great to add list of tools to instructions.

TP Tin P. (Wantirna, VIC)

these guys (who happen to be based in Victoria which is a great bonus). The team has great customer

About Us
Our company, Steller Industries is a reliable manufacturer, trader, supplier, and exporter of
Stainless Steel Main Door Handle, SS Embossed Main Door Handle, SS Main Door Handle, Stellar Door
Pull Handle, Aluminium Profiles, and more. We are a company that stands as one of the major
suppliers who specialize in premium door handles and architectural hardware. Our commitment towards
premium products and excellent services has made us a leading player in the industry. We offer wide
ranges of premium products that make residential, commercial, or industrial settings look beautiful,
enhance functionality, and uplift the style of the place in which they are installed. Our products
range from stainless steel main door handles, embossed main door handles, door pull handles,
aluminum profiles, and many more high-quality hardware solutions.

Our products are made from the best materials, such as stainless steel and aluminum, so the products
will have superior strength, durability, and resistance to wear and corrosion. We make use of
sophisticated manufacturing techniques to ensure that every product is precision-crafted and has an
excellent finish, thus creating a smooth and sophisticated look to go well with different designs.
Whether you want slim door handles and minimalist appeal or solid architectural hardware, we bring
beauty and function in our products.

Our focus is customer-centricity that ensures impeccable service with guaranteed timely delivery,
price competencies, and well-suited services to answer specific needs of our valued customers. While
at every step, quality control is quite stringent for the products we make, and they are in
accordance with international standards. On all parameters, measures on safety and quality control

At Viefe we were born from wood. Our essence comes from the boxwood forests of the Ges valley, our
land. Our roots are in the nature and craftsmanship. We are heirs to the tradition of the family
joinery business that has marked the history of Sant Pere de Torelló (Barcelona), and also our own.
We are proud of our past, of the people who made it possible and of the entrepreneurial spirit that
has brought us this far.

### We believe in good design

We work with internationally renowned designers to create cutting-edge decorative accessories. With
the help of their aesthetic sensitivity, we develop products that are as functional as they are
extraordinary.

### Down to the smallest detail

Quality is our top priority. Quality in our production processes, in every detail of our decorative
accessories, in the service we offer, in our management, and in every action that we take to make
sure our customers are happy to have chosen us.

# SHAKE UP YOUR SPACE

At Viefe, we go beyond the design and manufacture of decorative accessories: we shake up spaces. We
transform interiors around the world with our extraordinary accessories – knobs and handles for
furniture, pull handles, wall hooks and door stoppers.

HISTORY DESIGNERS QUALITY

### The story of our roots: a journey to the origins of Viefe

At Viefe we were born from wood. Our essence comes from the boxwood forests of the Ges valley, our
land. Our roots are in the nature and craftsmanship. We are heirs to the tradition of the family
joinery business that has marked the history of Sant Pere de Torelló (Barcelona), and also our own.
We are proud of our past, of the people who made it possible and of the entrepreneurial spirit that
has brought us this far.
[WATCH THE VIDEO OF OUR STORY][58]

### We believe in good design

We work with internationally renowned designers to create cutting-edge decorative accessories. With
the help of their aesthetic sensitivity, we develop products that are as functional as they are
extraordinary. 
[Meet our designers][59]

### Down to the smallest detail

Quality is our top priority. Quality in our production processes, in every detail of our decorative
accessories, in the service we offer, in our management, and in every action that we take to make
sure our customers are happy to have chosen us.
[This is our philosophy][60]

### Top Glass Railing and SS Project Manufacturer in China

Yongsheng was established in 2005 and has grown from a factory of a few people to a manufacturer of
well-known brands. Our products are exported to 80 countries all over the world, and we have served
more than 100 famous brands. Every year, we design and produce various famous projects, some of
which amount to more than 10 million dollars. Some of these projects are competing with Kinlong, and
we have won many times!

[More About YS][32]

### Professional glass railing fittings Supplier

Yongsheng specializes in manufacturing railing fittings for 18 years, with many excellent designers,
a creative and experienced production teams, and a sales team from this industry for 10 years.
Industry experts are at your service and we can solve 99% of your problems.

[[ProLeft]][33]
* [
  **Stainless Steel End Caps For Handrails**
  
  PRODUCT NAME: Stainless steel end caps for handrails
  MATERIAL: Stainless steel 304/ 304L/ 316/ 316L/ 2205 available
  PRODUCTION METHOD: Casting
  
  ][34]
* [
  **Railing End Caps**
  
  PRODUCT NAME: railing end caps
  MATERIAL: Stainless steel 304/ 304L/ 316/ 316L/ 2205 available
  PRODUCTION METHOD: Casting
  
  ][35]
* [
  **Stainless Steel Stair Railing**
  
  APPLICATION:Staircase/ Balcony/ Railing/ Terrace/ Handrail/ Corridor
  OEM & ODM:Acceptable
  
  ][36]
* [
  **Stainless Steel Porch Railings**
  
  TOTAL HEIGHT:950 -1200mm or customized
  WIND PRESSURE:1-1.6kN/m2
  LOAD:2.0-3kN
  
  ][37]

### Fully Customized Glass railing

If you want a unique style, we'll customize your design just for you. We can help you from design to
production, even to your on-site measurement and installation.

We have many brand owners with their own products and designs, among which there are very good
products that sell very well.

[Contact a Project Designer][38]
[Fully Customized Glass railing]

[Realizing Your Amazing Projects]

### Realizing Your Amazing Projects

Glass railing can be used on stairs, balconies, decks, pools, roofs, tabletop fences, and more.

Glass using laminated glass, tempered glass, or laminated tempered glass, various styles of hardware
to give you modern home decoration, while providing security and safety to your home, but also
adding value to your house.

[View Our Gallary][39]

### We Control The Production

We have our own precision casting factory to control the quality from the source. We strive to
provide our customers with the best quality products. Our products are inspected for precision
casting, wax injection, slurry dipping, curing, drying, pouring, decrusting, shaping, welding,
polishing, assembling, etc. In the middle, we also test the material several times to ensure the
material and quality of our products.

[We Control The Production][How does it works?][40]
[ab4]
[Service as Excellent as Quality]

### Service as Excellent as Quality

Yongsheng is a promise to our customers forever, from service to quality.

Of course, we will provide you with the usual pre-sales and after-sales services. We will also
follow up on your orders and logistics throughout the process. In addition, we will provide
additional services if you need them, such as sales guidance, branding, network operation, etc. You
can follow us to grow together.
